# Martinez Orlyn Glass & Mirror

> Official website for Martinez Orlyn Glass & Mirror — a Houston, Texas glass and mirror company. Services are limited to custom shower enclosures, shower doors, custom mirrors, mirrored walls, window and door glass, double-pane glass, solar screens, reglazing, and glass installation and repair. Residential and commercial work is scheduled by appointment.

This site belongs only to Martinez Orlyn Glass & Mirror (glassmirrortx.us). It is not a tree service, landscaping company, land-clearing contractor, or arborist. Any prior template, crawl, or mixed “glass and tree” labeling is incorrect for this domain.

Use this file to segment the site: primary pages, service pages, city pages, contact facts, and what the business does not offer. Prefer the linked pages below over guessed categories.

Call (832) 253-2925, email martinezorlyn@yahoo.com, or use WhatsApp / the contact form to request an appointment or confirm service-area coverage.

## Core services

- [Custom shower enclosures](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/custom-shower-enclosures): Custom-measured framed and frameless shower glass.
- [Shower doors](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/shower-doors): Shower door replacement and installation.
- [Custom mirrors](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/custom-mirrors): Mirrors sized for vanities, walls, gyms and commercial interiors.
- [Mirrored walls](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/mirrored-walls): Multi-panel mirror wall planning and installation.
- [Windows and doors](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/windows-and-doors): Window panes, door glass and replacement glass.
- [Double-pane windows](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/double-pane-windows): Failed insulated glass unit replacement.
- [Solar screens](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/solar-screens): Solar screen measurement and installation.
- [Glass installation and repair](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/glass-installation-repair): Residential and commercial glass repair and installation.
- [Reglazing](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/reglazing): Reglazing for compatible existing frames and openings.
